input.prompt: A new panel cut from the very same antique hand-painted Srikalahasti kalamkari cotton cloth as the reference image. Copy the reference exactly for: its deep madder red ground, its ecru-and-madder lotus-and-vine scroll border with two thin dotted bands running around all four edges, its dense dotted and cross-hatched fill patterns, its slightly irregular freehand iron-black kalam lines, its visible coarse cotton weave and slight dye bleed. Photographed flat and straight-on, the cloth fills the entire frame edge to edge. It must look like a real centuries-old craft textile, not a digital illustration: lines wobble slightly and vary in thickness, fills are hand-dotted. Scene inside the border: an afternoon seaside cafe terrace on a green hillside above the sea. Foreground, large and central: a young man and a young woman seated facing each other across a small round table, deep in conversation, each holding one coffee cup, leaning in. Both are drawn strictly in the classical kalamkari figure manner, exactly like temple-cloth figures: pure side profile faces, one large elongated almond eye drawn frontally, long sharp nose, stylised curved fingers, outlines filled with dotted pattern. The young man (left, in side profile facing right): short black hair, neat short black beard, thin round spectacles drawn in profile, a checked shirt in indigo and ecru squares, and full-length trousers dyed solid indigo blue with a fine dotted pattern covering both legs down to his ankles, sandals. The young woman (right, in side profile facing left): long black hair in a single long braid with a flower tassel, a simple top in myrobalan yellow with dot pattern, and full-length trousers in madder red with small ecru dots. Each person has exactly two arms and two hands with five fingers. To the far left and far right edges, much smaller in scale, three friends sit around a low table with small cups, chatting: two on the left, one on the right, also in kalamkari profile style. Behind: a low terrace railing with potted plants, green hillside with dotted texture and palm trees, then the sea as stylised rolling indigo waves with ecru crests and patterned fish, two small sailboats, and a large round afternoon sun in turmeric yellow ringed by lotus-petal rays against the madder red sky. Palette strictly natural vegetable dyes: deep madder red, brick red, indigo blue, myrobalan-turmeric yellow, green from indigo over yellow, undyed ecru cotton, iron-black. Completely flat, no perspective shading, no gradients, no metallic gold, no 3D, no photorealism. Exactly five people in total. No text, no letters, no writing, no numbers, no signboard, no menu, no logos, no lamps, no diyas, no candles, no fire, no flames.
